intro: In Booty Bay, the old sea dog Dizzy One-Eye lost his sight in battle and sees only through a special enchanted glass eye. Bloodsail Buccaneers ambushed him last night and took it, and Dizzy asks for help getting the eye back.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Argh, I am but useless without me special enchanted eye. Bad enough to have lost me eyes in battle in the first place! But by some stroke o' luck we docked in Menethil and a traveling wizard enchanted a special glass eye that let me see again.
Last night I ended up gettin' jumped by some Bloodsail Buccaneers on me way out. Took me eye, they did! Seems those blokes have found their way to Booty Bay.
Help an old sea dog out by gettin' me eye back?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ahoy, me bucko! Might not be able to see but I can smell ye from halfway across port.
Could really use me eye back. Captain's going to keelhaul me when he finds out me peeper is in the hands of them dirty Bloodsail Buccaneers.
What good is a lookout who can't see? The crow's nest used to be me home...without me deadlights I'd be lucky to scrub the bilge.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Shiver me timbers and timber me shivers! Ye found me beautiful eye! Let's see if she still fits.
Friend ho! Blimey, I can see!!
